_doc: Effort per engine (brief 2.3, 2.7). Owner: effort. Schema: TankContentSchema.validate_stations, which also holds every number here to the brief's safety envelope (BRIEF 4.6.1, 4.6.2, 4.6.6, 4.6.8): G2 tuning cannot move one past it. Plans: per engine and segment type, the PlanPhase mode and its numbers; every engine needs an entry for every segment type of its table; the mission file gives each segment's kind and length. WARMUP-kind segments (the depot, the drill's skirmish) use the warm-up numbers of the boiler (3% x min(pressure, 1)), the hoist (1%) and terrain (0..+2%). Bank (pattern 1): every target is clamp(base_pct + span_pct x (1 - bank/100), lo, hi) of the rider's phase effective_range(), clamped before the max_step_pts limit and the sub-steps; it runs in every dynamo phase with a range_pct (stages, boss and the drill's skirmish, so 55..65 there), never in the depot or checkpoints. The SIM power band the director publishes is tanks.json in_band.sim_ftp_pct (one source); the first 300 s is TankConst.FIRST_S.

boiler._doc: Pattern 2: grade_pct x min(pressure, 1) in WORK SIM phases, warmup_grade_pct x min(pressure, 1) in WARMUP-kind ones; 0 while loaded or cycling.

hoist._doc: Pattern 3 (the Bulwark): rise_pct_s per second in whole step_s steps counted from reaching Hoist, up to grade_pct (warmup_grade_pct in WARMUP kinds), only in SIM phases; 0 in one step on leaving Hoist.
